name: The Last Shutter
idea: Closing time. The shutters along this stretch are coming down, and the only way on is the way to another floor.

say: A chime, then the whine of motors. Down the passage, shop shutters start to lower, one after another.
found: Under the last shutter with a whisker to spare.
Someone behind it claps. A station stamp for your book, for nerve.
missed: A night cleaner lifts it a hand's width, just enough for a kitten, and waves you through. Next time.

say: A shutter already down. Taped to it, a paper sign: 本日の営業は終了しました. Business is over for today.
A cleaner's cart, left mid-mop. The floor shines and smells of lemons.
The shutters stop short of here. They always have.
